admin_api_key.description: Admin API key. Only needed when managing organizations. Can also come from LANGFUSE_ADMIN_KEY.

host.description: Base URI of the Langfuse instance (defaults to https://app.langfuse.com).

adapter.description: The LLM service type. Valid values: anthropic, openai, azure, bedrock, google-vertex-ai, google-ai-studio.

base_url.description: Optional base URL override for the LLM provider API.

config.description: Adapter-specific configuration as a JSON string.

custom_models.description: Optional list of custom model identifiers.

extra_headers.description: Optional map of additional HTTP headers for LLM API requests.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the LLM connection.

project_public_key.description: The project public key used to authenticate API calls.

project_secret_key.description: The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

provider_name.description: The unique name identifying this LLM connection within the project. Changing this value destroys and recreates the resource, as the provider name is the upsert key.

secret_key.description: The API authentication key for the LLM provider.

with_default_models.description: Whether to include default models. Defaults to true if not set.

block.description: Manages an LLM connection in a Langfuse project.

metadata.description: Metadata for the organization as key-value pairs.

name.description: The display name of the organization.

organization_id.description: The Langfuse organization the key belongs to.

public_key.description: The public value of the API key (only returned at creation time).

secret_key.description: The secret value of the API key (only returned at creation time).

email.description: The email address of the user to invite.

id.description: The unique identifier of the membership.

organization_private_key.description: Organization private key to authenticate the call.

organization_public_key.description: Organization public key to authenticate the call.

role.description: The role to assign to the user. Valid values are: ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER.

status.description: The status of the membership invitation.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

block.description: Manages membership in a Langfuse organization.

metadata.description: Metadata for the project as key-value pairs.

name.description: The display name of the project.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization that owns this project.

organization_private_key.description: Organization private key to authenticate the call.

organization_public_key.description: Organization public key to authenticate the call.

retention_days.description: The retention period for the project in days. If not set, or set with a value of 0, data will be stored indefinitely.

note.description: Optional note for the API key (POST /api/public/projects/{projectId}/apiKeys). Because the Langfuse public API only accepts a note at creation time, changing this attribute forces replacement: the old key is deleted and a new one is created (new id and credentials).

organization_private_key.description: Organization private key to authenticate the call.

organization_public_key.description: Organization public key to authenticate the call.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the key belongs to.

public_key.description: The public value of the API key (only returned at creation time).

secret_key.description: The secret value of the API key (only returned at creation time).

email.description: The email address of the user to add to the project.

id.description: The unique identifier of the project membership.

organization_private_key.description: Organization private key to authenticate the call.

organization_public_key.description: Organization public key to authenticate the call.

role.description: The role to assign to the user. Valid values are: OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER, NONE.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

block.description: Manages membership in a Langfuse project.
